decision.location: Results, Identification of previously reported acne-associated variants; References; Supplementary Tables S1 and S2 (Reference [1])
decision.quote: A systematic literature search identified 7 independent GWAS on acne ( Figure 1 ). From these studies, 88 previously reported acne-associated variants were extracted for replication analysis ( Supplementary Table S1 ). All variants had shown suggestive evidence of association in previous reports, defined by a significance threshold of P < 1 × 10 −5 . Among them, 5 variants (rs80293268, rs1256580, rs2901000, rs629725, and rs34560261) had been reported in more than 1 previous acne GWAS.
decision.reason: Resolving the Luna triage hold regarding variant-to-study mapping, Supplementary Tables S1 and S2 in the supplied source text explicitly map Reference [1] (He et al., 2014, Nat Commun 5:2870, doi:10.1038/ncomms3870) to three East Asian (Han Chinese) acne susceptibility variants (rs7531806 at 1q24.2, and rs747650 and rs1060573 at 11p11.2) and empirically retest them in 2,741 acne cases and 2,235 controls from the SMCGES cohort using additive logistic regression (Table S2: rs7531806[1] via tag-variant rs3917698, P = 0.02009; rs747650 & rs1060573[1] via tag-variant rs11039112, P = 0.5992; neither meeting the Bonferroni threshold P < 5.68e-4). This 2014 Han Chinese GWAS is an independent study with distinct cohorts and loci from the only shipped original (input_row_index 1291, Mitchell et al., 2022, doi:10.1038/s41467-022-28252-5, Reference [3]) and from all sibling targets, so report equivalence does not apply.

corrected_value.title: Genome-wide association study identifies three novel susceptibility loci for severe acne vulgaris

decision.location: Results, Replication analysis of previously reported acne-associated variants; Table 2; References; Supplementary Tables S1 and S2 (Reference [5])
decision.quote: Of the 88 previously reported acne-associated variants, 71 were represented in the SMCGES dataset by either the reported variant itself or a proxy variant in strong linkage disequilibrium (r 2 ≥ 0.8). After accounting for duplicate proxy mapping, these corresponded to 68 unique variants that were tested in the replication analysis ( Supplementary Table S2 ). Additive logistic regression identified 2 variants that exceeded the conservative study-wide significance threshold on the basis of the 88 literature-derived acne-associated variants after Bonferroni correction ( P < 5.68 × 10 −4 ) ( Table 2 ). These were rs1159268 at 1q41 and rs738409 at 22q13.31. Both variants showed effects in the same direction as previously reported. No additional variants met the corrected significance threshold.
decision.reason: Resolving the Luna triage hold, Supplementary Tables S1 and S2 explicitly map Reference [5] (Navarini et al., 2014, Nat Commun 5:4020, doi:10.1038/ncomms5020) to its three novel severe-acne susceptibility loci in a UK population (3,956 cases and 7,102 controls: rs1159268 at 1q41, rs38055 at 5q11.2, and rs478304 at 11q13.1), all three of which are empirically retested in the SMCGES cohort in Table S2 (rs1159268[5], P = 5.53e-4; rs38055[5], P = 0.9959; rs478304[5] via proxy rs537786, P = 0.1469). Moreover, Table 2 in the main text highlights rs1159268 (with Navarini et al.'s exact sample size 3,956/7,102, OR = 1.17, P = 4.08e-8) as one of the paper's two Bonferroni-replicated signals alongside rs738409 from the shipped original Mitchell et al. (2022, input_row_index 1291, Reference [3]). Navarini et al. (2014) is a separate primary GWAS article whose specific lead variants were independently extracted and retested, so it is genuinely absent from the shipped dataset.

All 88 extracted variants from the 7 GWAS were evaluated for genotyping and linkage-disequilibrium proxy representation (r2 >= 0.8) in the SMCGES cohort (Figure 1) and included in the 88-variant study-wide Bonferroni replication threshold (P < 0.05/88 = 5.68e-4), although neither variant from [6] passed the post-imputation/LD-proxy representation filter to appear among the 68 unique regression-tested variants in Table S2 (leaving its target-specific outcome cannot_be_determined).
